pages.title: Hill Top Zone
pages.text: Hill Top Zone is the fifth level of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (Sega, 1992). Its tune is 1 minute 36 seconds long in VGMPF's list.

pages.title: A slower kind of tune
pages.text: In the Sonic Stadium Soundtrack Squad Review (2010), the reviewer JezMM listed Hill Top Zone, Aquatic Ruin Zone and Oil Ocean Zone as the slower tunes of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 that felt "either repetitive or just a bit dull" to him.

pages.title: A different Sonic 2
pages.text: The version of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 for the 8-bit Master System and Game Gear has a completely different soundtrack, by Masafumi Ogata, Naofumi Hataya and Tomonori Sawada, according to Wikipedia.
